crossRefs.note: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out, and said to them, “Who are you looking…
They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with…
Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said…
They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

people.name: Capernaum
people.line: Town in Galilee; center of Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
translations.bsb: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
translations.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
translations.asv: when the multitude therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
